This document

 depended on external or internal leakage. This valve is used for isolate main 
 steam (90 bar, 520 ْ
ج)

 quality control's head sector.

The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks to surround the work area.

Wear 
 the safety and healthy equipment as: safety

sections.text: Prior to disassembling, open the valve more than 1/3 of total left.

Remove the actuator bolts (12), and retighten the gland packing, and then lock 
 the stem (05).

Turn the actuator handle clock wise and disengage the actuator (7) from the 
 stem (5), and then hang it with rope from the ceiling.

Take out the yoke clamp, and disengage the yoke (11) from the body (1) then 
 hang it with rope from the ceiling
Loosen the nuts (15) on the bonnet bolts (14) at this point.

Hit lightly on the upper rim of the retaining ring (6) so as to loosen it 
 counter clock wise, then take away the retaining ring from the bolt, and 
 remove the seal ring (8).

Disengage the combination block comprising the stem(5), disc (3) and bonnet 
 (2) etc. from the body (1). In this case the care should be taken to avoid 
 damage to contact surface. And identification marks on the body and disc 
 should be checked to avoid misplacing of the disc in reassembling.
Remove the eye bolts (13) and eye bolts clamp.
